query: 'SELECT
    CAST(diagnosis_id AS INT) AS diagnosis_id,
    CAST(admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN LEN(raw_icd) > 3 THEN LEFT(raw_icd, 3) + '.' + SUBSTRING(raw_icd, 4, LEN(raw_icd))
            ELSE raw_icd
        END AS VARCHAR(50)
    ) AS icd_code,
    CAST(diagnosis_description AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS diagnosis_description,
    CAST(severity AS VARCHAR(50)) AS severity
FROM (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(d.diagnosis_id)) AS diagnosis_id,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(d.admission_id)) AS admission_id,
        REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(
            CASE
                WHEN CHARINDEX(',', d.icd_code) > 0
                    THEN LEFT(d.icd_code, CHARINDEX(',', d.icd_code) - 1)
                ELSE d.icd_code
            END
        ))), '-', ''), '.', '') AS raw_icd,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(d.diagnosis_description)) AS diagnosis_description,
        CASE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.severity)))
            WHEN 'mild' THEN 'Mild'
            WHEN 'moderate' THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN 'severe' THEN 'Severe'
            WHEN 'critical' THEN 'Critical'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS severity
    FROM bronze.diagnoses d
    INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
        ON CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.admission_id)) AS INT) = a.admission_id
) AS t',
